description: This Java source file defines the AccessSourcer class, which generates access modifiers (e.g., public, private, static) as strings for Java source code based on Java class, field, or method access flags. It provides methods for interpreting integer access flags and outputting corresponding modifier keywords.

classes.name: AccessSourcer
classes.description: A class that takes an output object and generates Java access modifier strings based on supplied access flags and context (class, field, method).

methods.name: write
methods.description: Generates a list of access keywords (e.g., 'public static') based on the given access flags and context filter.
